issues.legal_issue: A perpetual lease of endowed property granted without legal necessity binds the endowment only during the granting manager’s lifetime.
material_facts: A manager of the endowment granted a perpetual lease of its property at a fixed rent.
No legal necessity for the perpetual lease was alleged or proved.
The granting manager died, and the occupants remained in possession without paying rent to the endowment.
issues.conclusion: The lease endured only during the granting manager’s lifetime and terminated on his death.
issues.legal_principle: A manager of a math lacking legal necessity cannot grant a perpetual lease binding the math beyond the manager’s lifetime; the manager may grant a lease enduring for that lifetime.

rule.if: suit_seeks_recovery_of_endowed_property and lease_granted_by_endowment_manager and no_legal_necessity and granting_manager_died

predicates.suit_seeks_recovery_of_endowed_property: A party brought a suit seeking recovery of property belonging to a religious endowment.
predicates.lease_granted_by_endowment_manager: A manager of the endowment granted a lease of its property.
predicates.no_legal_necessity: No legal necessity for the lease was established.
predicates.granting_manager_died: The manager who granted the lease died.

issues.definition: When a recovery suit concerns endowed property leased by its manager without established legal necessity, the lease ends on the granting manager’s death.

issues.legal_issue: The absence of a legally appointed manager does not suspend limitation against a math when possession of its property becomes adverse.
material_facts: After the lease ended, the occupants possessed the lands on their own behalf and adversely to the math.
The math had no legally appointed manager when the possession became adverse.
The adverse possession continued for the period required for limitation to run.
issues.conclusion: Limitation ran against the math despite the absence of a legally appointed manager, and the math’s title was extinguished when the limitation period was completed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Article 144 read with section 28 of the Limitation Act, 1908, limitation for recovery of property runs from when the defendant’s possession becomes adverse, and completion of the period extinguishes the owner’s title. A math is a juristic person capable of owning property and suing; it may act through a de facto manager, and, where necessary, beneficiaries may take steps to protect its rights. The Court followed the majority view in Venkateswara v. Venkatesa, and relied on Mahadeo Prasad Singh v. Karia Bharti and Vithalbowa v. Narayan Daji Thite. It distinguished Jagadindra Nath Roy v. Hemanta Kumari Debi, where a shebait existed at the start of limitation and claimed the benefit of a disability provision.

rule.if: suit_seeks_recovery_of_math_property and possession_became_adverse_to_math and no_appointed_manager_when_adversity_began and limitation_period_completed

predicates.suit_seeks_recovery_of_math_property: A party brought a suit seeking recovery of property belonging to a math.
predicates.possession_became_adverse_to_math: A person possessed the math’s property on their own behalf in a manner adverse to the math.
predicates.no_appointed_manager_when_adversity_bega: The math had no legally appointed manager when the possession became adverse.
predicates.limitation_period_completed: The possession continued for the period required for limitation to run.

issues.definition: When adverse possession of math property continues through the required limitation period, the math’s title is extinguished even if no legally appointed manager was in office when the adverse possession began.

issues.legal_issue: Appointment of a new manager does not create a fresh right to recover property whose title the math had already lost by adverse possession.
material_facts: Limitation began running against the math while it had no legally appointed manager.
The limitation period was completed and the math’s title was extinguished before a new manager was elected.
The new manager later sought recovery of the property on behalf of the math.
issues.conclusion: The new manager’s appointment did not give the math or the manager a new right to recover the property or a fresh starting point for limitation.
issues.legal_principle: Under Article 144 read with section 28 of the Limitation Act, 1908, once adverse possession extinguishes the math’s title, the rights of its beneficiaries in the property are also extinguished. A later manager acquires no right to recover property that no longer belongs to the math. The Court relied on the principles concerning the math’s ownership and capacity to sue discussed in Vidya Varuthi Thirtha v. Balusami Ayyar and The Commissioner, Hindu Religious Endowments, Madras v. Sri Lakshmindra Thirtha Swamiar of Srirur Mutt.

predicates.suit_seeks_recovery_of_math_property: A party brought a suit seeking recovery of property belonging to a math.
predicates.limitation_period_completed_before_new_m: The period required for limitation to run was completed before a new manager was appointed.

issues.definition: If the math’s recovery claim is brought after limitation has completed and extinguished its title, appointing a new manager does not restore that title.

issues.legal_issue: Voluntary delivery of possession to a math does not transfer title back to it after another person has acquired title by prescription.
material_facts: The occupant acquired title by prescription after possessing the land adversely to the math for the required period.
The occupant later voluntarily delivered possession to the math.
The math’s title had already been extinguished before that delivery.
issues.conclusion: The voluntary delivery of possession did not transfer title to the math.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 28 read with Article 144 of the Limitation Act, 1908, completion of adverse possession extinguishes the former owner’s title and vests prescriptive title in the possessor; the later delivery of possession alone does not transfer that title back.

predicates.suit_seeks_recovery_of_math_property: A party brought a suit seeking recovery of property belonging to a math.
predicates.possessor_acquired_title_by_prescription: A possessor acquired title after possessing the property adversely for the required limitation period.
predicates.possession_voluntarily_delivered_to_math: After acquiring title, the possessor voluntarily delivered possession of the property to the math.

issues.definition: When a possessor has acquired title by prescription, later voluntary delivery of possession to the math does not transfer title back to it.
